name: hypamoon
description: Hypamoon turns what you build in the chat into something your team actually uses: a website or app with sign-in and its own data, forms, a shop, email from your own domain, and a link to the systems you already use.

interface.longDescription:
Hypamoon turns what you build in the chat into something your team actually uses. Describe it, and the assistant builds it and keeps it running on Hypamoon: a website or app with sign-in and its own data, forms, a shop and email from your own domain.

What you can do:
- Put a website online on its own address or your own domain, change it later in the chat, and go back to an earlier version if you want. You can also bring over an existing site.
- Build an app for your team, where everyone signs in and works with the same information.
- Collect information: contact requests, bookings or orders come in through a form on your site, and you read and update them in the chat.
- Sell: add products, a cart and a checkout to your site, with shipping, VAT, discount codes, gift cards and paid access, and follow up on orders and invoices. The money goes to your own payment account, which you connect once in your Hypamoon account.
- Photos and files: add them from your phone or computer through an upload page, and use them on your site.
- Email: send email from your own domain.
- Use the systems you already have: read from a CRM or other business system that the owner connected to Hypamoon, within the access the owner allowed. Every change waits for the owner's approval.

How it works: connect your Hypamoon account. Every account has a test project, so you can build and try everything first. Phone numbers, the AI voice, website chat and helpers are managed in your Hypamoon account.
defaultPrompt: Build a one-page website for my hair salon with a booking request form and publish it with Hypamoon.
Open a small shop on my website for my handmade candles, with a cart, shipping in Europe and a welcome discount code.
Show me the booking requests that came in through my website this week.
